guides.title: WhatsApp Document Printing
guides.description: Print documents, tickets, and agreements received through WhatsApp.

steps.instruction: Open WhatsApp on the shop computer.
Open the customer's chat.
Find the document (PDF, Word, or text file).
Download the document to the computer.
Open the Downloads folder.
Right-click the downloaded file and select Print (or open in PDF viewer).
Check the printer selection, page orientation, and paper size (A4 / Legal).
Select 1-sided or 2-sided (duplex) as requested and click Print.
Collect the printed document and inspect print quality.

guides.title: WhatsApp Image Printing
guides.description: Print photos, receipts, and screenshots received through WhatsApp.

steps.instruction: Open WhatsApp and navigate to the customer's conversation.
Click and open the photo or screenshot sent by the customer.
Click the Download button at top right to save it in full resolution.
Open the downloaded image file from the Downloads folder.
Press Ctrl + P to open the Print picture dialog.
Choose the correct paper tray (Glossy Photo Paper or Plain A4).
Select layout: Full page, 4x6 photo, or 2 images per page.
Set print quality to Best / High for photographs.
Click Print and inspect the finished image.

guides.title: Aadhaar Card Printing
guides.description: Print Aadhaar card sides according to the customer's requested layout.

steps.instruction: Open the customer e-Aadhaar PDF file.
Enter the password (first 4 letters of name in CAPITAL + year of birth YYYY).
Locate the front side and back side sections of the ID.
Use Snipping Tool or Adobe Snapshot tool to capture front and back cleanly.
Arrange both front and back on a blank A4 sheet (side-by-side or stacked).
Confirm card dimensions (standard 8.6cm x 5.4cm or enlarged if requested).
Select thick cardstock or photo matte paper in printer tray.
Choose High Quality color print settings and print.
Cut the card carefully along borders and laminate if requested.

guides.title: Black & White Xerox
guides.description: Make single-sided or double-sided black-and-white photocopies.

steps.instruction: Lift the Xerox machine scanner platen glass lid or use auto document feeder.
Align original document face-down against the top-left alignment mark.
Close scanner lid gently without shifting the paper.
Select Mono / Black & White on the Xerox control console.
Select duplex option: 1-sided to 1-sided OR 1-sided to 2-sided.
Verify paper tray selection (Tray 1: Standard A4 75gsm).
Adjust density (darker/lighter) if the original text is faint.
Enter the number of copies needed on the numeric keypad.
Press the green Start button and examine the output copy.

guides.title: Colour Printing
guides.description: Print colour documents, project charts, posters, and certificates.

steps.instruction: Open the customer document (PDF, Word, PowerPoint, or graphic file).
Review margins, page orientation, and slide fit on screen.
Press Ctrl + P and select the Colour Laser or Ink Tank printer.
Click Printer Properties / Preferences.
Set Output Color to Color (ensure Grayscale is disabled).
Select media type: Plain 80-100gsm paper, Glossy, or Matte brochure.
Set print quality to High / Presentation mode.
Check page range so only required colour pages are printed.
Click Print and wait for printout to fully dry.

guides.title: Email PDF Printing
guides.description: Download PDF attachments from customer emails and print them.

steps.instruction: Open the shop email account (Gmail / Webmail).
Locate the customer email and check for attached PDF files.
Click the Download icon to save the PDF to the shop PC.
Open the downloaded file in Adobe Acrobat Reader or Chrome.
Press Ctrl + P to open the Print dialogue box.
Ensure the correct printer is selected and paper tray has ample paper.
Select 'Fit' or 'Shrink oversized pages' so text is never cropped.
Confirm single-sided vs double-sided (duplex) with customer.
Click Print, staple if multi-page, and hand to customer.
